subsystems.name: Cell lines
subsystems.role: the living starting material — animal or plant cells selected to grow fast and reproducibly in a tank.

subsystems.name: Culture medium
subsystems.role: the liquid feed supplying sugars, amino acids, vitamins, salts and signalling proteins.
parts: recombinant growth factors made by precision fermentation

subsystems.name: Bioreactor
subsystems.role: the vessel where cells multiply in a warm, stirred, oxygenated liquid.
parts: pH, dissolved oxygen and temperature probes

subsystems.name: Scaffold and structuring
subsystems.role: gives cells somewhere to attach and builds meat-like texture rather than loose paste.

subsystems.name: Harvest and downstream
subsystems.role: separates cells from liquid, washes them and forms the final food.

subsystems.name: Facility and utilities
subsystems.role: keeps everything clean and sterile enough for food, at industrial volume.

buildSteps.title: Bank the cells
buildSteps.detail: A small tissue sample is taken and its cells are grown in the lab, then frozen in vials as a master bank so production never needs another animal.

buildSteps.title: Adapt to suspension and serum-free growth
buildSteps.detail: Cells that normally cling to surfaces are trained over many generations to float free in a stirred tank and to thrive without animal serum.

buildSteps.title: Mix the medium
buildSteps.detail: Food-grade nutrients are dissolved in water, and growth-factor proteins are produced separately by precision fermentation using engineered microbes, then added.

buildSteps.title: Run the seed train
buildSteps.detail: Cells are stepped up through progressively larger vessels — from millilitres to hundreds of litres — each stage seeding the next so the tank is never overwhelmed.

buildSteps.title: Seed the production bioreactor
buildSteps.detail: The vessel is filled with medium, brought to roughly body temperature, and seeded with cells plus edible scaffold or microcarriers.

buildSteps.title: Grow under perfusion
buildSteps.detail: Fresh medium is fed in and spent medium drawn out continuously, holding pH, oxygen and temperature steady while cells multiply for days or weeks.

buildSteps.title: Harvest and recycle
buildSteps.detail: Cells are separated from the liquid; residual nutrients and growth factors are recovered and reused, which is the main lever on cost.

buildSteps.title: Shape and finish
buildSteps.detail: The cell mass is combined with binders, fats and edible scaffold, then moulded, layered or printed into burgers, nuggets or fillets, and chilled or frozen.

buildSteps.title: For plant cells, run the same loop with plant tissue
buildSteps.detail: Cocoa, coffee or fruit cells are cultured in sugar-based medium in the dark, then dried or formulated into a food ingredient.

prerequisites.why: serum-free recipes exist, but the growth-factor proteins remain expensive enough to dominate production cost.
recombinant proteins and enzymes are already made industrially, but capacity and price must improve for food volumes.
pharmaceutical vessels are far smaller; cultivated meat needs much bigger, cheaper, food-grade tanks.
flat minced products are within reach, but whole cuts need structures that hold shape while cells grow through them.
the first approvals came in Singapore in 2020 and the United States in 2023; most countries still have no pathway.
heating, stirring and cooling large vessels for weeks is energy-intensive, so grid carbon intensity shapes the climate benefit.

pathway.milestone: first regulatory clearances and small restaurant servings
pathway.unlocks: proof that the food is safe and can be legally sold.

pathway.milestone: larger perfusion bioreactors and on-site medium recycling
pathway.unlocks: unit costs falling toward the price of conventional meat.

pathway.milestone: hybrid products — plant protein blended with cultured fat — on ordinary supermarket shelves
pathway.unlocks: volume sales without needing whole-cut technology.

pathway.milestone: plant-cell ingredients such as cultured cocoa or coffee at commercial scale
pathway.unlocks: protection of crops vulnerable to climate change.

pathway.milestone: structured whole cuts from continuously running, energy-efficient plants
pathway.unlocks: cultivated meat as a routine commodity rather than a premium niche.
